# Settings reference

Every setting lives in the registry. The configuration window, the MSI properties and the `Set-ErpPrinterSetting` cmdlet all write the same values.

| Scope | Machine value (GUI, MSI, scripts) | Policy override (GPO, Intune) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Global | `HKLM\SOFTWARE\ErpPrinter` | `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\ErpPrinter` |
| Printer profile | `HKLM\SOFTWARE\ErpPrinter\Printers\<profile>` | `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\ErpPrinter\Printers\<profile>` |

A value under `Policies` wins and shows as read-only in the configuration window. A profile that exists only under `Policies` is fully managed by policy. Secrets are never read from `Policies`.

## Global settings

### Storage

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DataRoot` | REG_SZ | `%ProgramData%\ErpPrinter` | Data folder. Outbox, failed/sent archives, logs and downloaded updates are stored here. Locked to SYSTEM and Administrators. |
| `KeepSentDays` | REG_DWORD 0-3650 | `0` | Keep sent documents (days). 0 deletes documents as soon as they are delivered. |
| `LogLevel` | REG_SZ: `Error`, `Warning`, `Information`, `Verbose` | `Information` | Log level. |
| `LogRetentionDays` | REG_DWORD 1-3650 | `14` | Keep logs (days). |

### Delivery

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PollIntervalSeconds` | REG_DWORD 2-3600 | `15` | Poll interval (seconds). How often the uploader re-scans the outbox. New print jobs wake it immediately. |
| `MaxAttempts` | REG_DWORD 0-100000 | `0` | Max delivery attempts. After this many failed attempts a document is moved to the failed folder. 0 retries forever. |
| `RetryMaxBackoffMinutes` | REG_DWORD 1-1440 | `60` | Max retry backoff (minutes). Retries back off exponentially from 30 seconds up to this ceiling. |
| `MaxDocumentSizeMB` | REG_DWORD 1-2048 | `64` | Max document size (MB). Larger documents are moved to the failed folder instead of being uploaded. |
| `HttpTimeoutSeconds` | REG_DWORD 5-3600 | `120` | HTTP timeout (seconds). |
| `ProxyUrl` | REG_SZ | (empty) | Proxy URL. Optional, e.g. http://proxy:8080. The service runs as SYSTEM and does not see per-user proxy settings. |

### Updates

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AutoUpdate` | REG_DWORD 0/1 | 1 (on) | Install updates automatically. |
| `UpdateManifestUrl` | REG_SZ | `latest.json of the latest release of this project` | Update manifest URL. HTTPS URL or UNC path of latest.json. Defaults to the latest GitHub release of this project. |
| `RequireSignedUpdates` | REG_DWORD 0/1 | 0 (off) | Require Authenticode-signed updates. |
| `UpdateSignerThumbprint` | REG_SZ | (empty) | Update signer thumbprint. If set, update packages must be signed by this certificate. |

## Printer profile settings

### Printer

| Name | Type | Default | Backends | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Enabled` | REG_DWORD 0/1 | 1 (on) | all | Enabled. |
| `PrinterName` | REG_SZ | the profile name | all | Printer name. Name of the Windows printer users will see. |
| `PipeName` | REG_SZ | `ErpPrinter-<profile name>` | all | Pipe name. The printer port is \\.\pipe\<name>. Change only if it collides with something else. |
| `FileNameTemplate` | REG_SZ | `{title}` | all | File name template. Tokens: {title} {user} {username} {domain} {computer} {date} {time} {datetime} {id} {jobid} {profile}. |

### Connection

| Name | Type | Default | Backends | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Backend` | REG_SZ: `OdooJson2`, `OdooJsonRpc`, `ERPNext`, `Webhook` | `OdooJson2` | all | Backend. OdooJson2: Odoo 19+ JSON-2 API. OdooJsonRpc: Odoo 14-18 /jsonrpc. ERPNext: Frappe upload_file. Webhook: POST to any URL. |
| `ServerUrl` | REG_SZ | (empty) | all | Server URL. Base URL of the ERP (https://example.odoo.com) or, for Webhook, the full endpoint URL. |
| `Database` | REG_SZ | (empty) | OdooJson2, OdooJsonRpc | Database. Needed when the Odoo server hosts several databases. |
| `Username` | REG_SZ | (empty) | OdooJsonRpc | Login. Login of the Odoo integration user that owns the API key. |
| `ApiKey` | REG_BINARY (DPAPI), under `Secrets\<profile>` |  | all | API key. Stored encrypted (DPAPI, machine scope) in a registry key only SYSTEM and Administrators can read. For Webhook this is the auth header value. |
| `ApiSecret` | REG_BINARY (DPAPI), under `Secrets\<profile>` |  | ERPNext | API secret. |

### Destination

| Name | Type | Default | Backends | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OdooModel` | REG_SZ: `documents.document`, `ir.attachment` | `documents.document` | OdooJson2, OdooJsonRpc | Odoo model. documents.document needs the Documents app (Enterprise). ir.attachment works on Community. |
| `OdooFolderId` | REG_DWORD 0-2147483647 | `0` | OdooJson2, OdooJsonRpc | Documents folder ID. Target folder for documents.document. 0 leaves it unset. |
| `OdooResModel` | REG_SZ | (empty) | OdooJson2, OdooJsonRpc | Attach to model. For ir.attachment: model of the record to attach to, e.g. res.partner. |
| `OdooResId` | REG_DWORD 0-2147483647 | `0` | OdooJson2, OdooJsonRpc | Attach to record ID. |
| `OdooExtraFields` | REG_SZ | (empty) | OdooJson2, OdooJsonRpc | Extra fields (JSON). JSON object merged into the created record. Template tokens are expanded, e.g. {"description": "Printed by {user}"}. |
| `UserMapping` | REG_DWORD 0/1 | 0 (off) | OdooJson2, OdooJsonRpc | Map Windows users to Odoo users. Looks up the printing user in res.users (login or email) and sets owner_id on documents.document. |
| `UserEmailDomain` | REG_SZ | (empty) | OdooJson2, OdooJsonRpc | User email domain. Optional. Also tries <username>@<domain> when mapping users. Active Directory mail/UPN are tried automatically. |
| `ERPNextFolder` | REG_SZ | `Home` | ERPNext | File folder. |
| `ERPNextDoctype` | REG_SZ | (empty) | ERPNext | Attach to DocType. |
| `ERPNextDocname` | REG_SZ | (empty) | ERPNext | Attach to document. |
| `ERPNextIsPrivate` | REG_DWORD 0/1 | 1 (on) | ERPNext | Private file. |
| `WebhookFormat` | REG_SZ: `Multipart`, `Json` | `Multipart` | Webhook | Payload format. Multipart: file plus metadata form fields. Json: base64 content plus metadata. |
| `WebhookFileField` | REG_SZ | `file` | Webhook | File field name. |
| `WebhookAuthHeader` | REG_SZ | `Authorization` | Webhook | Auth header name. The API key is sent as the value of this header, if one is set. |
